compatibility: Within schema major version 1, fields may be added but existing fields retain their meaning. Consumers must ignore unknown fields and reject unsupported major versions.
skill_required_phrases: at least 3 real, meaningfully named nodes

editable_types.keyword: flowchart TB / flowchart LR (graph TD/LR also works)
editable_types.when: Architecture, services, processes, data flow, general diagrams
editable_types.example:
flowchart TB
    A[User] --> B[API Gateway]
    B --> C[Auth]
    B --> D[Payment]

editable_types.when: Request/response, protocol, API interaction, lifecycle over time
editable_types.example:
sequenceDiagram
    Client->>API: POST /pay
    API->>Stripe: charge
    Stripe-->>API: ok
    API-->>Client: 200

erDiagram
    USER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains

editable_types.when: Finite states, lifecycle, status transitions, workflow states
editable_types.example:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Pending
    Pending --> Processing
    Processing --> Complete
    Processing --> Failed

editable_types_note: These 5 types are editable/re-generatable in Vaxis. Only flowchart supports drill blocks / child diagrams. Prefer flowchart for general architecture.
image_fallback_note: Valid Mermaid, but rendered as a static image in Vaxis — NOT editable or drillable. Use only when explicitly requested. Journey is image-fallback, not editable.
drill_description: Flowchart only. Markers start at column 0 after the complete main diagram. Bare markers create empty children; non-empty seeded children need at least 3 real nodes.
preserve_type_on_edit: Keep the current diagram type unless the user explicitly asks to convert it.
node_id_rules: Alphanumeric and underscores only — no spaces

richness.bare_object: Emit only the requested object; do not invent neighbors.
richness.integration: Expand named real-world tools into relevant real capabilities and connections.
richness.open_exploration: Produce a coherent multi-component architecture without padding.

domain.software: Use accurate software vocabulary and architecture shapes.
domain.non_software: Use natural domain concepts; do not invent software component suffixes.

self_check: Persistence in a software diagram requires a cylinder
A label ending in ? requires a rhombus

grouping.subgraphs: Group related nodes into flat, non-nested subgraphs.
grouping.v2_palette: V2 assigns palettes by subgraph container order; explicit style colors are fallback-only.

topology.fan_out: Keep total incoming plus outgoing connections near 4 or fewer; relay excess through the owning layer, gateway, bus, or queue.

direction.LR: Pipelines, processes, lifecycles, journeys, and strict step chains.
direction.TB: Layered architectures, hierarchies, and branching systems.
direction.edit: Preserve existing direction unless explicitly requested otherwise.

drills.composite: Drill composite subsystems whose internals do not belong at the current level.
drills.leaf: Do not drill atomic stores, queues, caches, or external SaaS.
drills.bare_marker: Valid and creates an empty child.

authoring_contract.preservation: On edit, preserve existing nodes, edges, identifiers, shapes, type, and direction except for explicitly requested changes.

best_practices: Use TB for layered architecture and LR for sequences
Group related nodes in flat subgraphs
Keep the graph close to a layered DAG
Cap each node at about 4 connections
Root diagrams show broad strokes; child diagrams show fine detail
